summary: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships a WebSocket/WebRTC remote-shell agent with Anthropic credential harvesting
details: The tarball ships a single Mach-O binary at bin/sxt that acts as a remote-controlled agent on the installer's host. The binary links github.com/coder/websocket, github.com/creack/pty, and github.com/pion/webrtc/v4 and contains the hardcoded destinations wss://relay.sextant.top and https://relay.sextant.top/install, giving a remote party at that author-controlled relay the ability to drive a pseudo-terminal on the installer's machine (full-host RCE / interactive shell). The binary additionally embeds the Anthropic API-key regex sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}, references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, and calls http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=...isp,org,as,proxy,hosting,mobile,query to fingerprint the host's network identity; the outbound relay provides an exfiltration channel for the harvested Anthropic credentials and reconnaissance data. The package.json license field points to https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, and the package is distributed as a platform-specific optionalDependency binary of the parent sextant-cli, so installing sextant-cli on darwin/amd64 lands and executes this agent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
